subject.title: feat(browser): return inline page state after navigation

question: Should successful browser navigation always attach a compact snapshot by default, accepting the bounded additional model context in exchange for fewer model turns?
rationale: This is a new default behavior for a broadly exposed agent tool, and the linked canonical request is explicitly awaiting maintainer product direction; implementation correctness alone cannot choose the response-cost tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt compact inline state
options.body: Approve the compact, capped snapshot as the default navigation result after real direct and proxied browser proof confirms the documented behavior.

options.title: Keep snapshot explicit
options.body: Retain the current separate snapshot workflow until maintainers choose a narrower or opt-in response contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt compact inline state
recommendation.body: Approve the compact, capped snapshot as the default navigation result after real direct and proxied browser proof confirms the documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed problem statement and proposed contract, so they are the available contact for clarifying the intended user workflow; approval itself remains a repository maintainer decision.
